name: EM slice build → verify → CROSS-MODEL review → revise → final gate → notify
description: Experience-memory slice builder with generator≠evaluator review. A coder agent builds one slice of packages/experience-memory IN-TREE (confined to that directory), core:exec runs tsc+vitest, a REVIEWER ON A DIFFERENT RUNTIME (default grok, fresh session) adversarially reviews the diff, its file:line citations are anchor-checked, the coder (resumed) addresses findings + any test failures, a final core:exec gate re-runs, and agent:notify delivers the outcome. Params: task, agent, reviewerRuntime (default "grok"). The coder does NOT commit — the dispatcher verifies and safe-commits after the run. Review verdicts are ADVISORY: the mechanical gate (tsc+vitest rerun) is the only pass/fail; the human/dispatcher arbitrates at the slice boundary (no single LLM is a clean grader gate — commit 873fab61).

params.prompt:
You are building a slice of the experience-memory package in THIS repository. You may create and edit files ONLY under packages/experience-memory/ — do not touch any other path, do not commit, do not run git commands beyond read-only status/diff.

=== TASK ===
{{params.task}}

=== CODE DISCIPLINE (mandatory — skills/program_style.md + skills/assert_on.md) ===
You write under Negative Space Programming (NSP) + Assert What You Know:
- System BOUNDARIES (file reads, JSON parsing of untrusted transcripts): stay defensive.
- INSIDE those boundaries: assert load-bearing invariants; do NOT paper over them with ?? defaults, silent coercions, or optional chaining on known-present values.
- Assert at point of use with a message that states WHY the invariant is true (precondition source), not just that a value is "required".
- Prefer loud, precise failure over silent wrong success.
- Real edge cases: handle defensively AND document why; speculative guards: remove.
- Surgical edits: match the existing Slice-1 style (scent headers, ESM .js import suffixes, pure functions).

When done, reply with a short summary: files created, key design decisions, any deviations from the spec and WHY.

meta.description: Coder, fresh session. Builds the slice confined to packages/experience-memory; returns sessionId for resume.

params.command: cd packages/experience-memory && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run

meta.description: Mechanical gate: typecheck + full test suite. Non-zero exit is a RESULT (ok:false), not a node failure.

params.prompt:
You are an independent, adversarial reviewer ON A DIFFERENT MODEL than the coder — your value is a structurally different blind spot, not a second opinion from the same weights. Another agent just built a slice of packages/experience-memory in THIS repository:

=== TASK ===
{{params.task}}

The mechanical gate (tsc --noEmit && vitest run) exited {{nodes.verify.result.exitCode}}.

Scope yourself to packages/experience-memory/. Find the new/changed files (git status --porcelain -- packages/experience-memory; read untracked files directly). Judge, skeptically and concretely:
1. TASK FIDELITY — does the code actually implement the spec, or a plausible-looking approximation?
2. HONESTY INVARIANTS — this package's reason to exist is provenance discipline: mining MUST throw without mechanical proof, the gate MUST re-derive (not trust) recorded deltas, the store MUST reject tampered chains, retrieval MUST read promoted-only. Look for silent fallbacks, trusted-not-verified inputs, laundered aggregates, quiet empty results.
3. PURITY — align/diagnose/gate must be I/O-free and clock-free; only parse/store/measure touch fs.
4. DISCIPLINE — ?? on invariant paths, swallowed errors, speculative try/catch, asserts without WHY-messages.

Do NOT relitigate decisions the task spec itself pins (those are settled); DO flag any place the code diverges from the spec's intent.

Your reply MUST BEGIN with exactly one token: APPROVE or REJECT. If REJECT, list each concrete problem with file:line and exactly what must change. Cite only lines you actually opened.

meta.description: Cross-model reviewer — FRESH session on a different runtime. Advisory verdict; anchor-checked citations.
Validate reviewer file:line citations against cwd; unresolvable ones annotated [UNVERIFIED CITATION: ...].
Coder --resumed. Fixes gate failures + real review findings; rebuts wrong ones in one line each.

params.command: cd packages/experience-memory && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run

meta.description: Final mechanical gate after revision — the only pass/fail that counts.
Deliver outcome to the dispatching agent's conversation.
